audit_items.proof_trace: The Get() method skips missing indices (L441-442: continue) and returns partial sidecar sets when only some requested indices are available. The streamDataColumnBatch() handler streams whatever Get() returns without validating completeness, violating the all-or-nothing atomicity requirement. The test case at rpc_data_column_sidecars_by_range_test.go:L100-103 demonstrates this: slot 40 has only indices [4,6] stored but both are included in the response even when index 5 is also requested.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker requests DataColumnSidecarsByRange for indices [4,5,6]. A block with only indices [4,6] stored triggers HasAtLeastOneIndex (L412) to pass, then the loop skips index 5 (L441-442), and the handler streams sidecars 4 and 6 without verifying all requested indices are present. Peer receives incomplete data for that block, breaking the protocol invariant that all sidecars for a block must be included together if any are included.
